Name: Harvey new look (Seasonal)
Author: pinzol
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]UPDATED FOR 1.6 + SEASONAL OUTFITS + AEROBICS DAY and SCHEDULE + ???[/size][/color][/b]

Harvey's new portraits and sprites. Harvey is a sweetheart and I'm giving him all the love he deserves. I went all out and about for him, so this is not just the outfits mod anymore, it's much more.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6573/6573-1717100240-1398362863.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Added [b]Seasona[/b]l outfits + [b]Beach[/b] outfit + [b]Indoor[/b] outfits for Fall and Winter.
[*]Slightly edited his [b]Spouse room[/b] and his room above the clinic.
[*]Toggle[b] Glasses[/b] and [b]Mustache[/b] on and off.
[*]Added [b]Hospital[/b] outfit. Harvey will wear it everyday in Hospital except: when it's a sunny Friday or any Saturday. He will not wear it when he's got Aerobics.
[*]Added a new [b]Reading animation[/b] cycle for Saturdays, when Harvey's reading in the Museum. Always found it strange that he's just standing there.
[*]Added [b]Aerobics[/b] Outfit. Added new animation cycles for his new [b]Aerobics schedule[/b] and [b]Aerobics class[/b] on Saturday. (Read below under [b]Details[/b]).
[*]Edited his [b]6-heart event[/b] so that he shows there in his new outfit, portraits and sprites.
[*]Added a[b] Secret[/b] outfit. Why? Because I was losing my mind after two weeks of updating this mod and needed to have more fun with it (Read below under [b]Details[/b]).
[/list]
[b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Aerobics Details:[/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler]
[size=4][color=#00ff00]Important! New Aerobics feature will only start working [/color][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4]after you've seen his 6-heart event.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4]1. [b]Days: 3, 12, 15 and 26. Around 12 a.m in Spring, Summer and Fall. It must be sunny or cloudy outside

[/b]Harvey will work out a bit around town. He will head out to the same locations as his usual schedule on  [b]Days 3 and 15[/b], but will do some exercises instead of just standing there. On[b] Days 12 and 26[/b] he will work out straight in the middle of central plaza for everyone to enjoy the view. 

[/color]2. [b]Days: 6, 20. New Aerobics Class. [b]The weather must NOT be rainy[/b]

[/b]Harvey will join Caroline, Jodi, Emily and Leah for the new class on Saturday. It takes the same time and place as the class on Tuesday. I didn't include Marnie and Robin so that they won't leave their shops. Other NPC's schedules did not suffer from it in any way, I checked them all out. Leah and Emily attend this Class unless your Farmer is married to them. Emily will go straight to the Stardrop Saloon after it, as usual.

3. When Harvey works at the clinic on the day of his Aerobics routine, he'll wear Doctor's coat over his aerobics outfit when inside the Clinic.

4. If by any chance he visits the Ginger Island while wearing Aerobics outfit, he'll go around the Beach in it, but without boots and socks and with a slightly rolled up top (It's hot. On the Beach, I mean).

5. I did not change his marriage schedule. I reckon there are cool mods like [b]Immersive spouses[/b] that will do a better job with it.

6. You can turn his whole Aerobics schedule off or adjust it to your liking via Config. Look for "Aerobics In Town" option (Read more under [b]Configuration[/b]).

[size=4][color=#00ff00]Important! New Aerobics feature will only start working [/color][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4]after you've seen his 6-heart event.[/size][/color]
[/spoiler]
[b][size=4][color=#b4a7d6]Secret Outfit Details ???[/color]
[/size][/b][spoiler]
1. Harvey's the only doctor in town. I bet he's tired all the time. He will randomly go around town looking like someone after a 12-hour shift. He will continue with his daily schedule as usual, whether it's working at the clinic, going to the beach or working out. He'll just look a tad out of it. Which is relatable, honestly.

2. There are 8 days out of 28 in every season when he might show up in this tired outfit. There's about 33% chance of him showing up in it on these days. There's also a 50/50 chance that he'll hold smth in his hands.

3. In Winter he wears a scarf over this outfit. Gotta keep him warm.

4. If by any chance he visits the Ginger Island while wearing his secret outfit, you'll see his special Beach outfit for the occasion.

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Warnings!

[/size][/color]1. He might show up like that to the Flower Dance and Spirit's eve festivals. Wedding and other Festival events will be okay.

2. If you've got any heart event scheduled for him and Harvey happens to wear this outfit at that moment, he'll sport this drowsy look throughout the whole cutscene. To me - it's hilarious. But it might ruin it for others so you can wait for another day before going into the heart event or turn this whole thing off in the config. Look for "Tired Harvey" option (Read more under [b]Configuration[/b]).

[/spoiler]
-------------------------------------------------
[color=#ffff00][b]How to install:
[/b][/color][list]
[*]Have Content patcher installed
[*]Download archive and drop the folder inside the archive into your Mods folder
[*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change [b]config.json[/b] file in the mod's folder manually.﻿
[*]Highly recommend using [color=#f4f4f4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305]Schedule viewer[/url][b] [/b]by[b] [/b]BinaryLip to check NPC's schedules and outfits. ﻿[/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]
[/color]
[/list]-------------------------------------------------
[color=#ffff00][b]Configuration options:
[/b][/color][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][b]Glasses [/b](True/False) - turn glasses on/off for All portraits and sprites.[/color]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][b]The Return of the Mustache[/b] (On Portraits and Sprites, On Portraits only, No Mustache) - turn mustache on/off. "On Portraits only" option will show it only on Portraits and not sprites, as it might look silly on sprites, gotta be honest.[/color]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][b]Aerobics In Town (after seeing 6-hearts event)[/b][/color]
﻿﻿-[b] Full Aerobics [/b][color=#f4f4f4]- Harvey works out around town AND in Class on Saturday,
[/color]﻿- [b]Only Harvey [/b]-[b] [/b][color=#f4f4f4]Harvey only works out around town, there's no class on Saturday,
[/color]﻿- [b]Only Class [/b][color=#f4f4f4]-Harvey only works out in Class on Saturday,
[/color]﻿[b]- No Aerobics [/b]- just turn this feature off completely[/list][color=#f4f4f4]
[list]
[*][b]Tired Harvey[/b] (True/False) - Harvey randomly walks around town looking tired after all his hard work. Turn it off completely whenever you like.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Spouse room[/b] (True/False) - Turn on/off my edit of Harvey's spouse room
[/list][list]
[*][b]Harvey's room above the Clinic[/b] (True/False) - Turn on/off my edit of Harvey's room above the clinic
[/list]
------------------------------------------------- 
[color=#ffff00][b]Warning:
[/b][/color]This mod can and will conflict with any other mod that changes Harvey's appearance. It might also conflict with mods that edit Harvey's schedule except for spouse schedule. It will also conflict with mods that change spouse rooms or his hospital room.
[/color]
-------------------------------------------------

Downloads.Description: Harvey's new look, 1.6. New portraits and character sprites. Seasonal version + Aerobics outfit + Secret outfit + glasses on/off + mustache on/off + edited rooms. Also a new Aerobics Class and schedule for Harvey!

Includes outfits: Seasonal , Indoors , Hospital, Aerobics outfit for 6-heart event. Glasses, Mustache and Spouse room edit. You can turn them all off individually through config.
Doesn't include: Aerobics workout and class schedule, Secret bonus outfit
